features.title: Engineered for Serious Training
features.subtitle: From programming 8-client rosters and managing gym facility catalogs to tracking personal PRs solo, Gymmi provides professional tools built for performance.
features.routineDesc: Construct high-impact, multi-day routines with surgical precision. Configure supersets, rest intervals, target rep ranges, and target RPE with an intuitive, flexible builder.
features.bodyMapDesc: Explore our anatomical muscle map. Target specific muscle groups—Chest, Lats, Quads, Hamstrings, Deltoids, Core—and filter exercises by equipment with zero friction.
features.activeDesc: Track sets, reps, and perceived exertion in real time. Dynamic rest timers and completion checkmarks keep athletes focused on every single set.
features.trainerDesc: Establish structured coaching contracts, deliver bespoke training blocks directly to client mobile devices, and maintain automated routine forking for customized progression.
features.classificationsDesc: Classify client and member performance into calibrated tiers (Diamond, Platinum, Gold, Silver, Bronze) based on peak estimated 1RM using Epley's formula. Filter by weekly, monthly, or all-time windows.
features.classificationsF1: Scientific 1RM calculation calibrated with Epley's peak formula
features.classificationsF2: 5 standardized strength tiers from Bronze to Diamond
features.classificationsF3: Core compound lift prioritization (Squat, Bench Press, Deadlift, Overhead Press)
features.classificationsF4: Cohort filtering across Weekly, Monthly, and All-Time performance cycles
features.facilityDesc: Supervise your fitness facility with centralized routine catalogs, member capacity tracking, and coach affiliation permissions. Built to help local gyms and athletic clubs scale.
features.facilityF1: Curated facility workout routine catalog accessible to all active gym members
features.facilityF2: Coach affiliation requests with granular routine publishing toggles
features.facilityF3: Real-time member roster tracking with tier capacity visual indicators
features.facilityF4: Facility-wide strength leaderboards and collective cohort tracking
features.aiDesc: Break language barriers instantly. Custom exercises, descriptions, and coaching notes are automatically translated between English and Spanish using Google Gemini AI.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: When an athlete enters an active training contract with a coach, they become a Covered Client. The coach manages their active training program, temporarily locking solo routine creation while giving the athlete full access to execute and log their coach's prescribed workouts.
faq.q2: Can I switch between Free and Plus?: Can I switch between Free and Plus?
faq.q2: Can I switch between Free and Plus?
faq.a2: Yes. Upgrades immediately expand your client capacity and template limits. If you downgrade, a 24-hour grace period is granted before overflow routines or exercises are softly hidden—never deleted.
faq.q3: Where do athletes access the mobile app?
faq.a3: Gymmi Mobile is built natively for iOS and Android, allowing athletes to log weights, record RPE, and check off sets in real-time right on the gym floor.
faq.q4: How does Gemini AI translation work?
faq.a4: Gymmi utilizes Google Gemini AI to translate custom exercises and routine instructions automatically between English and Spanish, enabling seamless bilingual coaching.
faq.q5: When will the Pro tier be available?
faq.a5: The Pro tier is currently in active development. It will introduce unlimited client capacity, team collaboration for fitness studios, and advanced analytics.
faq.q6: How do Strength Standards & Leaderboards work?
faq.a6: Gymmi automatically computes peak estimated 1RM using Epley's scientific formula across logged exercise sets. Athletes achieve calibrated strength tiers (Diamond, Platinum, Gold, Silver, Bronze) on core compound lifts. Facility coaches and gym owners can track cohort rankings across weekly, monthly, and all-time cycles.
faq.q7: How does Gymmi work for gym facilities and studios?
faq.a7: Gym facilities receive a dedicated management web console. You can curate facility-wide workout catalogs, approve personal trainers to represent your gym with optional routine publishing rights, track active member capacity against your tier (starting at 100 members with a 30-day free trial on Plus), and publish exclusive member announcements.
